displayName: Turn off automatic updates for Windows App
description:
Controls how the Windows App checks for and installs updates.

If you enable this policy, choose one of the following options:
  
  Enable updates: Windows App will automatically check for and install updates from all sources.
  Disable updates from all locations: Windows App will not check for or install updates from any source.
  Disable updates from the Microsoft Store: Windows App will not download updates from the Microsoft Store but may still update from other sources.
  Disable updates from non-store CDN location: Windows App will not download updates from non-store CDN sources but may still update from the Microsoft Store.

If you disable or do not configure this policy, automatic updates are enabled for Windows App.
